sin_001: You can recognise it by its branches, arcing down to touch the ground and rooting into new trunks of their own. It stands near the Fonte dos Passarinhos, in Parque da Pena.
sin_002: You can recognise it by the ferns growing straight out of its bark, fenced but visible right at the roadside. It stands near Quinta do Relógio, on Rua Barbosa du Bocage.
sin_003: You can recognise it by its huge trunk, nearly ten metres round at the base. It stands in Parque da Liberdade.
sin_004: You can recognise it as the tallest tree in the garden, over 50 metres, rising above everything around the lake. It stands beside the ornamental lake in Parque de Monserrate.
